title: Starting a course
summary: Open a course for the first time and choose a motivator.
focus: The first start wizard and the two motivators
content:
## Open a course

Open the course list. Its title is *What would you like to learn?*. It shows ready-made courses and your own.

Press **Start learning** on a course card. The first time, a short wizard sets the course up.

## Choose a motivator

A motivator is how the app shows your progress. It sets the top of the course home page and the line you see at the end of a lesson.

- **Statistics and metrics** is the default. It shows your daily goal as a ring, your streak, lessons passed and terms collected.
- **XP** shows a level, a bar to the next level and the points you earn. XP raises your level like a character in a game.

Press **Get Started!** to open the course.

## Change it later

Each course has its own motivator. Use the gear on the course's card on the course list to change it.

Changing a motivator never resets anything. Your progress stays. The home page also has **Continue**, which takes you back to where you left off.

the effort you aim for each day, shown as a ring
the number of days in a row you practised

quiz.prompt: Which motivator do you wear when you have not chosen one?
quiz.explanation: Statistics and metrics is the default.
hints: The default shows a ring, a streak and counts.

quiz.prompt: Changing the motivator resets your progress.
quiz.explanation: Switching never resets anything. Progress, passes and points stay.

quiz.prompt: Where do you change a course's motivator after the first start?
options: The gear on the course's card
quiz.correct_answer: The gear on the course's card
quiz.explanation: The gear on the course's card on the course list opens the course's settings.

quiz.prompt: A motivator you choose in one course is used in every course.
quiz.explanation: Each course has its own motivator.

quiz.prompt: Which motivator shows a level and a bar to the next level?
quiz.explanation: XP shows a level badge and a bar to the next level.
hints: The name is two letters that stand for points.

sorts.title: Which motivator?

items.text: A bar to the next level
A line at the end that says Passed
A line at the end that says +45 XP

sorts.why: Statistics and metrics counts what you did. XP turns it into points and levels.
